title: Is This The Start Of A Massive Market Shift?
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: SpaceX's beat (rev $14.6B vs $12.9B, $4.4B profit) is lifting chips, memory and neocloud names after hours; warns not to over-celebrate before Meta/Tesla/IBM.

calls.reason: Neoclouds (CoreWeave, NBIS, IREN) technically oversold and fear fading after SpaceX results; up again after hours.
calls.quote: The neo cloud comebacks are here, and that's with Coreweave up 7%

calls.reason: Beat revenue/EPS but slight Q4 guide miss; at multi-year lows, <21 P/E fair-value play he would consider long-term, not expecting quick recovery.
calls.quote: it is such a fair value play that, right? If we're seeking deals and a deal is presenting itself, why not have some exposure?

calls.reason: Closed intraday short for profit; price retesting same resistance and still looks attractive to short, but will not hold overnight.
calls.quote: Even though it does look attractive at these levels, I need to respect it. We'll just save it for tomorrow.

notes: SpaceX up 6-7% after hours with Elon's $500B-1T ARR claim called a possible over-promise; no bias given, not recorded. NBIS and IREN mentioned alongside CRWV with same view.
